chunks: And with this chain, on the authority of Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them both), he said: Muhammad ibn Ali (peace be upon him) was asked about the prayer during travel.
He mentioned that his father (peace be upon him) used to shorten the prayer during travel.

key_terms.يُقَصِّرُ: Shortens (referring to reducing the number of rak'ahs in prayer)

ai.seo_question: How did the Imams practice shortening prayers during travel?
ai.summary: This narration from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights the continuous chain of practice (*sunna*) regarding shortening prayers during travel, linking Imam al-Baqir directly to his father, Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn. It serves as a key evidence in Shia jurisprudence for the permissibility and recommendation of *qasr* based on the Imams' consistent adherence to this prophetic tradition. The report underscores the reliability of the Ahl al-Bayt's practical application of divine law in varying circumstances.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-165 According to the same documentation, on the authority of Ja’far ibn Muhammad (a.s.) that Muhammad ibn Ali (a.s.) was questioned about praying on a journey.
He (a.s.) replied, “My father (a.s.) shortened his prayers while he (a.s.) was on a journey.”
